h:
将多个参考融合成一幅清晰、无缝的视觉杰作。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外- 在本地镜像之前，在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用- 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则非常有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配- 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时- 您想要完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望- 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

使用先进的 Krea 2 引擎，此工作流程可让您将多个参考图像混合成一个精致的视觉输出。您可以混合身份、服装、背景或产品参考，以进行无缝、高质量的编辑。该设置可自动执行参考权重、平衡风格而不会损失保真度。非常适合保持角色一致性或测试创意场景。通过设计、时尚或营销视觉效果的受控图像融合增强您的项目。所有元素顺利协同工作，提供清晰、逼真的合成结果。

重要节点：

Krea 2 多图像参考编辑 ComfyUI 工作流程中的关键节点

Krea2Edit重新平衡(#41)

平衡提示和多重引用的影响。调整image1_tokens, image2_tokens, image3_tokens，以及可选的image4_tokens优先考虑身份、服装/产品或环境。如果身份保真度下降，请增加第一张图像的重点；如果服装或灯光表现不佳，请调高其代币。该节点是调节再平衡自定义包的一部分：nova452/ComfyUI-调节-再平衡.

UNET加载器(#37)

加载综合骨干 Krea-2 Turbo，它确定基线样式和功能。保持此固定以确保整个活动的一致性，并且仅当您想要不同的渲染角色时才进行更改。官方重量和注释：韩国/Krea-2-Turbo和krea-ai/krea-2.

K采样器选择(#43)

选择采样算法，该算法塑造纹理和边缘行为。根据您的主题，使用它来以速度换取清晰度或更柔和的渐变。将此处的选择与调度程序调整配对，以实现可预测、可重复的改进，而不是大规模重置。

基本调度程序（＃44）

控制步骤调度和整体噪声强度。较低的总细化可以保留更多的参考外观；更高的精细度推动模型更有力地重新解释内容。将此与采样器选择和调节重点结合起来进行调整，以达到忠实度和创造力之间所需的平衡。有关 sigma 调度概念的一般指导，请参阅 Karras 等人的扩散调度研究。在 arXiv 上。

分辨率选择器(#40)

设置填充潜在画布的长宽比和大小。将分辨率与主题比例和输出用途（肖像、产品英雄或场景）相匹配。较大的尺寸可以解析更多的纹理，但可能需要增加细化以稳定细节。

o.en:
Blend multiple references into one sharp, seamless visual masterpiece.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning - you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises- run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout- useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON- the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense- you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations- First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

Using advanced Krea 2 engines, this workflow lets you blend multiple reference images into one refined visual output. You can mix identity, clothing, background, or product references for seamless, high-quality edits. The setup automates reference weighting, balancing styles without losing fidelity. Perfect for maintaining character consistency or testing creative scenarios. Enhance your projects with controlled image fusion for design, fashion, or marketing visuals. All elements work together smoothly to deliver crisp, realistic compositing results.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in the Krea 2 multi-image reference editing ComfyUI workflow

Krea2EditRebalance(#41)

Balances the influence of prompt and multiple references. Adjustimage1_tokens, image2_tokens, image3_tokens, and optionalimage4_tokensto prioritize identity, wardrobe/product, or environment. If identity fidelity slips, increase the first image’s emphasis; if outfit or lighting underperforms, nudge their tokens up. This node is part of the Conditioning Rebalance custom package:nova452/ComfyUI-Conditioning-Rebalance.

UNETLoader(#37)

Loads the synthesis backbone, Krea-2 Turbo, which determines baseline style and capability. Keep this fixed for consistency across a campaign and change only when you intend a different rendering character. Official weights and notes:krea/Krea-2-Turboandkrea-ai/krea-2.

KSamplerSelect(#43)

Selects the sampling algorithm, which shapes texture and edge behavior. Use it to trade speed for crispness or softer gradients depending on your subject. Pair choices here with scheduler adjustments for predictable, repeatable improvements rather than wholesale resets.

BasicScheduler(#44)

Controls step scheduling and overall denoise strength. Lower total refinement can keep more of the reference look; higher refinement pushes the model to reinterpret content more strongly. Tune this in tandem with sampler choice and conditioning emphasis to reach the desired balance of faithfulness and creativity. For general guidance on sigma scheduling concepts, see diffusion scheduling research like Karras et al. on arXiv.

ResolutionSelector(#40)

Sets aspect ratio and size that feed the latent canvas. Match resolution to subject scale and output use (portrait, product hero, or scene). Larger sizes can resolve more texture but may require increased refinement to stabilize details.
